title: Tubulous
summary: TU'BULOUS, adjective Longitudinally hollow. 1. Containing tubes; composed wholly of tubulous florets; as a tubulous compound flower. 2. In botany, having a bell-shaped border, with five reflex segment

inlines.v: TU'BULOUS, adjective Longitudinally hollow. 1. Containing tubes; composed wholly of tubulous florets; as a tubulous compound flower. 2. In botany, having a bell-shaped border, with five reflex segments, rising from a tube; as a tubulous floret.
